comment: Environmental audio hooks (Phase B): where the Phase-B world makes a sound, and under which conditions - presentation only.
Each hook names its audio IDs; while an ID is not in the sound set (V3 has no wind, rain, thunder, river or insect sounds, and V3 is
not redesigned or regenerated), the hook is reported as awaiting audio and stays silent. A loop fades to its gain while its
conditions hold (gain_by: wind scales it by the world wind's strength); a one-shot fires at random within 'every_s'. Conditions:
'weather' (states it runs in; omitted: all), day_only / night_only, 'grounds' under the listener (world material IDs), 'near_ravine_m'
(within that many metres of the ravine's edge: the west, north and east edges).

hooks.note: The smithy's fire, heard across the waystation (the chimney smoke's sound).
The fold's own presence, under the Foldscar's V3 tone.
